question: How does facility delivery coverage compare across the four districts, and how has it changed over the three reporting years?

view.title: Facility delivery coverage by district and year
view.note: Each line shows one district. The vertical axis is the percentage of recorded deliveries that took place in a health facility. Source: Table 1, page 2. Values are illustrative and are not official statistics.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The report supplies percentages only; it does not supply counts or causal explanations, so the data cannot explain why coverage changed.
